description_en: Retrieves the project information of a specified schema design ticket and the information about the baseline database for changes in the ticket, including the status of the schema design ticket, the ID of the ticket creator, and the name and ID of the baseline database
description_zh: 调用此API可获取指定结构设计工单的项目信息以及工单的变更基准库的信息，包含结构设计工单的状态、工单创建者ID、基准库的名称和ID等
name: GetTableDesignProjectInfo

parameters.help_en: The ID of the schema design ticket. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465867.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
